# Northstar Design System

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere
Northstar is a calm monitoring surface for incident response.

## 2. Color Palette & Roles
Known semantic colors are paired with their intended roles.

## 3. Typography Rules
Typography keeps incident identity visible.

## 4. Component Stylings
Incident rows preserve status, owner, and next action.

## 5. Layout Principles
Reading order follows operational urgency.

## 6. Depth & Elevation
Elevation is reserved for blocking overlays.

## 7. Do's and Don'ts
Do preserve recovery context.

## 8. Responsive Behavior
Columns collapse without hiding status.

## 9. Agent Prompt Guide
Do not infer missing values.
